d: As part of the itinerary of Bihar's biggest culinary conclave, the organizing body, GTRI, curated a super exciting day-long gastronomic experience that featured a brief breakfast walk in the city followed by a traditional Bhoj (feast) in a mango orchard. Along with some of the dignitaries and organizers, we had a memorable day sharing food stories and memories around the traditional Bihari delicacies that were part of this food tour.
